# Destinus — Open Positions > This company has 121 open positions. Use the search endpoint to filter results. ## How to Search Send a **GET** request to `https://apply.workable.com/destinusgroup/jobs.md` with query string parameters: ``` https://apply.workable.com/destinusgroup/jobs.md?query=backend+engineer&department=Engineering&location[0][country]=Greece&location[0][region]=Attica&location[0][city]=Athens&workplace=remote&worktype=full ``` All parameters are optional. Combine multiple filters to narrow results. `query` is free text search across job titles and descriptions. For `department`, `workplace`, and `worktype`, repeat the parameter to pass multiple values (e.g. `department=Engineering&department=Sales`). For departments, use the exact name from the list below — you can use a parent department (e.g. `Engineering`) or a sub-department (e.g. `QA`). For `location`, use bracketed indices with optional keys (`location[0][country]=Greece&location[0][city]=Athens`). Omit any keys you are unsure about (e.g. use just `location[0][country]=Greece` to match all cities).
